limits: 39 solver attempts completed without observed budget truncation; not 39 valid formal grades or semantic successes.
Two Coder null grades are diagnosed final-candidate SyntaxErrors after model reverted compatibility edits. Retain null, do not silently exclude them.
All 11 paired tasks are R2E from 5 repositories; no paired SWE task in this snapshot. Readiness-based sampling is not random.
Qwen raw1 Moto6114 has a real existing-Neptune regression confirmed with exact original source on new37-reference CPU diagnostics (reward0); distinct physical attempt, not rewriting old GPU result.
Qwen raw1 Pydantic6283 has PrivateAttr regression evidence and v2 CPU control rejection; original GPU FrozenPatch has NOT yet been actually regraded under v2.
Coder raw1 aio1c1 cancelled-main cleanup regression remains under bounded counterexample validation; no final semantic pass claim.
Old coverageEA69 input omitted a public requirement; old raw0 is not a clean difficulty estimate.
Some materials have changed since original attempts; covered28 means ever attempted, not current-version accepted28.
Global semantic accuracy is not computed before all verdicts/versions are reconciled.
Single sample per task/model does not measure stable per-task success or post-training learning gains.
Solve_seconds include model/tool orchestration; not pure GPU compute or environment/queue duration.
